description: This file defines the OAuthFlowService class, which manages OAuth token operations such as propagation, validation, exchange, and refresh within an authentication module. It interacts with repositories, Redis cache, and handles exceptions.

classes.name: OAuthFlowService
classes.description: Service class handling OAuth token operations such as propagation, validation, exchange, and refresh.

methods.name: propagateAccessToken
methods.description: Stores access token info in Redis cache and sets expiry.

methods.name: getOwnerId
methods.description: Retrieves owner ID for a given access token, checking cache first, then database.

methods.name: validateAccessToken
methods.description: Validates an access token's expiry, checking cache and database, throws exceptions if invalid or expired.

methods.name: readFromCache
methods.description: Reads token data from Redis cache to determine cache hit or miss.

methods.name: exchangeAuthorizationToken
methods.description: Exchanges authorization token for access and refresh tokens, invalidates old authorization token.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Refreshes OAuth tokens using client credentials and existing refresh token.

methods.name: _generateActKey
methods.description: Generates Redis key for access token cache.

methods.name: _generateOwnerIdKey
methods.description: Generates Redis key for owner ID cache.
